entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to return a helmet. Order number 55-Charlie-219.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up that order...
Look, I'm short on time. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?
Of course. I see the order for the Trail Helmet here. Just to be sure, what specifically is the issue? Is it a preference, like the wrong color, or something else?
It was a gift, never used. The box is unopened. It's just not needed.
Understood. One moment while I check the return eligibility. I see it was delivered 84 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for this helmet.
Alright, thank you for waiting. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.
Good. Send me the shipping label.

I've just sent it to the email on file. We always want to make sure you're completely satisfied with your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment. And because you're a VIP member, I've also included a 15% discount code in that email for your next purchase.
Okay, I've got it. That's helpful, thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
